diagram.render_note: The page picture (p.32) is a shaded illustration with no axis, no scale and no ground line, so apparent heights cannot be read from it exactly. The spec therefore draws Everest's summit exactly twice as high as Elbrus's above one ground line (10.0 and 5.0 drawing units; the true ratio 8848 / 5642 is about 1.57).
